name: deep-clone
description: Performs a deep, structural clone of JavaScript values including nested objects, arrays, Maps, Sets, Dates, RegExp, ArrayBuffers, TypedArrays, and handles circular references gracefully using a WeakMap reference tracker.
aiPromptContext: Use this block when you need a reliable, complete deep-copy that handles edge cases like circular references, Dates, Maps, Sets, and TypedArrays without using JSON.parse(JSON.stringify()) which loses type information.
